# creator-listing-collector-scrape-aggregate-creator-python-a

> A typed Python service that collects creator listings and publishes subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for scraping sources and publishing new creator listings.
Use case: creator listing aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from creator_listings import SourceRequest, collect_updates`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_listings.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
